title: Barchi ki ani qabr
body:
asghar ka laasha dhoondte phirte thay jab udoo
naize chubho chubho ke sar e dasht char soo
ek baar goonji dashte bayaban mein ye sada
baba jaan baba jaan baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani qabr talak aayi hai baba
asghar ne bhi seene pe sina khaayi hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab asr ko sab chaahne waale gaye maare
nusrat ko chala jhoole se haathon pe tumhare
hal min ki sada ran mein mujhe laayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqif thay sitamgar bhi meri tashnalabi se
hai pyaas bujhayi meri ek teer chala ke
sadaat pe ummat ne jafa dhaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
tay kar ke chala dasht se jab teer ki manzil
paywast hua naize mein nanha sa mera dil
tadpaya badan rooh bhi tadpayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene ko lahoo kar diya zaalim ki sina ne
manzar ye magar dekh liya qaime se maa ne
taqdeer meri maa ko kahan laayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
is waqt qayamat hui maidan mein barpa
wo neem hua naize se jab mera kaleja
yaade ali akbar ye mujhe aayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe ko lehad se meri naize pe utha kar
aada ne chalaya mere halqoom pe khanjar
ghurbat ki ghata kaise yahan chaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon naize pe rota tha ye sun kar sar e sarwar
altaf sada dete thay jab naize se asghar
asghar ne bhi seene pe sina khaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
author: Altaf Hussain
